C1490.title: Am I Eclipsed? A Smart Detector of Eclipse Attacks for Ethereum
C1490.summary: This study presents a smart detector designed to identify eclipse attacks in the Ethereum network. Eclipse attacks allow malicious actors to isolate a system user by controlling all outgoing connections, and such attacks are difficult to detect in blockchain applications.
